description: This file defines a React functional component named TodoInput, which provides an input box and submit button for adding new todo items to a list. It manages the input state internally and calls an external onAdd function when a new todo is submitted.

methods.name: TodoInput({ onAdd })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a form with an input box and a button to add new todo items. Handles user input, prevents default form submission, and invokes a callback to add the new todo.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission by preventing default behavior, trimming input, calling the onAdd callback with the new todo text, and resetting the input state.
